name: Death arrow

v1.prompt: Cartoon comedy, no blood, no red, no arrow or weapon in the picture: the cat jumps in fright as if something whizzed past its nose, then topples over backwards stiff as a board and lands on its back with all four legs straight up in the air, eyes as dizzy swirls, tongue out a little. The cat stays near the centre. Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: good: fright jump with dizzy swirl eyes, topples on its back legs up (used A's retry prompt); small dark streak 8-10, frame 14 smeared
